live.headline: BRONZE SATIN: a threat actor also tracked as HAFNIUM, Murky Panda and Silk Typhoon
live.in_short: BRONZE SATIN is the Secureworks name for an actor also called HAFNIUM, Murky Panda and Silk Typhoon. The catalogue lists two web shell tools. No public report in this library describes its operations.

sentences.t: BRONZE SATIN is the name Secureworks uses for this threat actor.
The actor is also tracked under the aliases HAFNIUM, Murky Panda and Silk Typhoon.
The catalogue record lists two tools for the actor: ChinaChopper and Godzilla Webshell.
No public report in this library describes its operations.
